The long and missing-content examples look sensible: long text stays contained, and absent descriptions or tags don’t leave awkward gaps. Letting me complete the details and save when a page can’t be read is also the right fallback.

For a large collection, search and tags won’t be enough on their own. I’d want to sort at least by date added and title, choose a default order, and limit how many bookmarks are shown at once with pages or a “load more” control. Newest-first can remain the initial default.

If I enter `example.com`, please assume `https://` and show the completed address in the review step.

I agree there’s no need for bookmarks to change automatically with time. Dates added and last edited should still be retained so date sorting works.
